questions.question: Which specimen or diagnostic finding belongs in a reference record for Dientamoeba fragilis?
options: Microfilariae in a peripheral blood film.
Malaria rings inside erythrocytes in a thin blood film.
Asymmetrical pinworm eggs on a perianal adhesive-tape specimen.
questions.explanation: Trophozoites in appropriately preserved stool. Permanent trichrome or iron-hematoxylin stains around 1000×; molecular assays improve detection.
